detail.title: Intex Thriller 1000 | Trolley Speaker (100W Power & 3 Hours of Playback)
detail.overview: Intex Trolley Speaker - 100W Power & 3 Hours of Playback The Intex Thriller 1000 is here to elevate your audio experience with powerful 100W sound and stunning RGB front lights. Designed for versatility, this speaker offers multiple play modes including FM, USB, AUX, MIC, and Bluetooth. Its dynamic sound with enhanced bass and treble control creates an immersive audio environment, whether you're hosting a party or enjoying your favorite tunes. With up to 3 hours of playback time, a cordless mic for karaoke sessions, and TWS connectivity for seamless pairing, the Thriller 1000 is the ultimate portable sound solution.
features: Multimode Playability: FM, USB, AUX, MIC, Bluetooth
RGB Front Lights for Visual Appeal
Up to 3 Hours* Playback Time (*Depends on Play Volume)
Full Touch Control for Volume, MIC Volume, Bass, Treble, and M.Echo
Digital Bass and Treble Control for Enhanced Audio
20.32 cm (8 in) x 2 Speaker Size for Rich Sound
Support for TWS Connectivity (True Wireless Stereo)
